description: The app's CPU (100% = one core), memory and threads; or, with frames, frames drawn since the last frames call: janky share, p50–p99 frame time, fps (iOS counts what the screen shows; its first frames call only starts counting, so call it before the action too). Simulator numbers are the Mac's: compare runs, not phones. A real iPhone reads through Instruments, 10–25 s a reading.

app.description: App id (default: the configured app, else the app in front)

device.description: Simulator UDID or adb serial, when several are booted. Remembered for later calls

for.description: Seconds to sample, a reading each second, then avg/max

frames.description: Frame and jank stats instead of CPU and memory

platform.description: When both an iOS and an Android device are booted. Remembered for later calls

name: perf
